page.overview:
What is Karambit?

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karambit karambit] is a small Indonesian curved knife resembling a claw from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minangkabau_people Minangkabau people] of West Sumatra. The karambit is one of the weapons commonly used in pencak silat and Filipino martial arts.

This weapon appears for the first time in the series in MK1, wielded by Smoke.
